name: r_p_0
description: Baseline periosteal radius of the humeral diaphysis (inferred from the order of magnitude of total area). Site-specific absolute values await full-text confirmation.

name: r_e_0
description: Baseline endocortical radius of the humeral diaphysis (inferred from the order of magnitude of medullary cavity area). Awaits full-text confirmation.

name: E_ref
description: Reference elastic modulus of cortical bone matrix (at f_bm = 1 and baseline mineralisation).

name: kappa_E
description: Exponent of E_app on f_bm. Awaits Currey 1988 / Gibson-Ashby. Sets the mechanical feedback gain; a key parameter for the bifurcation analysis (E6).

name: nu_E
description: Exponent of E_app on mineralisation. Awaits Currey 1988 / Gibson-Ashby.

name: f_bm_min
description: Numerical floor. Since E_app is proportional to f_bm^kappa, strain diverges as f_bm approaches zero.

name: eps_elastic_max
description: Yield strain of cortical bone, ~7000 microstrain (Bayraktar 2004; Morgan & Keaveny). NOT a model parameter but a validity boundary: the model assumes linear elasticity E_app = E_ref*f_bm^kappa_E throughout, and beyond yield that assumption fails, the tissue entering damage or fracture rather than adaptation. simulate() flags this as out.validity.ok; simulations at pathologically low f_bm trigger it. The highest strain in any normal scenario is the tennis-loading case at 2851 microstrain, well below this bound.

name: f_bm_0
description: Baseline bone matrix volume fraction of cortical bone (cortical porosity ~5%).

name: rho_min_0
description: Baseline mean tissue mineral density (ash-density scale).

name: M_L_0
description: Baseline peak bending moment of daily activity (humeral diaphysis). scenarioLibrary uses this as the 1.0x reference.

name: F_L_0
description: Baseline peak axial force of daily activity.

name: k_perm
description: Intrinsic permeability of the lacunocanalicular network. Awaits Weinbaum 1994.

name: mu_fluid
description: Viscosity of bone interstitial fluid (close to water at 37 C).

name: S_stor
description: Poroelastic storage coefficient. Awaits Weinbaum 1994.

name: a_canal
description: Canalicular radius (approximately 100-250 nm).

name: Gamma_PCM
description: Pericellular matrix shear-stress amplification factor. Awaits Weinbaum 1994.

name: L_poro
description: Poroelastic drainage path length (osteonal radius scale, canalicular network to Haversian canal). Together with c_p it sets the frequency corner.

name: K_tau
description: Lumped shear gain: peak shear stress tau_max per unit peak strain at f_0 = 1 Hz [Pa/strain]. Absorbs the three unknown microstructural parameters (a/2)*Gamma/S, and is set by the validation requirement tau in 0.8-3 Pa rather than by fitting any outcome.

name: alpha_f
description: [Retired at v1.5] Exponent of the original phenomenological surrogate function. Superseded by the closed-form |k tanh(kL)|, so frequency dependence no longer carries an adjustable exponent. Retained for comparison only.

name: f_c
description: [Retired at v1.5] Original phenomenological corner frequency. The actual corner is set by t_poro = L^2/c_p and is not a free parameter.

name: f_0
description: Reference frequency of the surrogate function (a defining constant).

name: tau_target_lo
description: Lower bound of the physiological fluid-shear-stress range, used for validation (not a model parameter).

name: tau_target_hi
description: Upper bound of the physiological fluid-shear-stress range, used for validation (not a model parameter).

name: tau_50
description: Half-activation shear stress of the mechanosensitive ion channel. Moved from M4 at v1.4. Awaits Li 2019 (Piezo1). A principal source of divergence in the bifurcation analysis (E6).

name: k_tau_sig
description: Steepness of the channel-activation sigmoid. Moved from M4 at v1.4, and now carries the supralinear role of the former phenomenological exponent q. Reduced from 0.30 to 0.12 at v1.5: at 0.30, k_co(0) reaches 3.4% of k_co_max and the resting open probability is 4.6%, so loading raises the daily dose by only 5.6% (the signal is swamped by baseline) and the disuse loss target V2 cannot be met. A value of 0.12 gives a sedentary-to-bedrest dose ratio of 8.4, which is reasonable. Still a placeholder pending Fu 2025.

name: k_co_max
description: Maximum closed-to-open rate. Awaits Fu 2025.

name: k_oc
description: Open-to-closed rate. Awaits Fu 2025.

name: k_oi
description: Open-to-inactivated rate. Governs saturation with cycle number (V4). Awaits Fu 2025.

name: k_ic
description: Inactivated-to-closed recovery rate. Governs the rest-insertion gain (V5); recovery time approximately 10 s. Awaits Fu 2025.

name: T_day
description: Seconds per day. Used to non-dimensionalise D_mech into a daily mean open probability.

name: J_max
description: Maximum Ca2+ influx rate (non-dimensionalised so that the baseline steady state is 1).

name: J_alt
description: Lumped term for parallel pathways (integrin, primary cilium, connexin 43). Its uncertainty is covered by the E6 sensitivity analysis.

name: k_C
description: Intracellular Ca2+ clearance rate (timescale of minutes).

name: k_Y
description: YAP/TAZ nuclear translocation rate.

name: K_Y
description: Half-saturation Ca2+ concentration for YAP/TAZ activation (dimensionless).

name: n_Y
description: Hill coefficient for YAP/TAZ activation.

name: delta_Y
description: YAP/TAZ deactivation rate.

name: beta_S
description: Basal sclerostin secretion rate. One of the divergence parameters in the bifurcation analysis (E6).

name: K_S
description: Half-saturation constant for YAP/TAZ inhibition of SOST. Recalibrated to 1.27 at v2.3 (previously 2.13): once mineralisation was made intensive (rho_min falling as new bone forms), disuse loss was no longer inflated by an erroneous mineralisation term, so a more sensitive mechanical SOST response was required. Sets V2 = 1.15%/month. V2 is highly sensitive to K_S (1.25 gives 1.28%/month, 1.30 gives 1.00%/month) - a steep transition near the set point, and a key finding of E6. Remains the core parameter of the mechanical set point.

name: h_S
description: Hill coefficient for mechanical inhibition of SOST.

name: delta_S
description: Sclerostin clearance rate.

name: delta_ab
description: Additional sclerostin clearance induced by the anti-sclerostin antibody (romosozumab). Refitted at v2.9: the former value of 0.09184 was fitted at v2.0 against V8 in the CORTICAL model, and that pass was later shown to depend on a mineralisation-inflation artefact, so the old value was a fit to a contaminated target. Moving V8 and V10 to the correct TRABECULAR compartment gave 0.24875. Refitted again to 1.65048 at v2.10: once the withdrawal-rebound mechanism was added, sost_reb also partially offsets the antibody during treatment, so delta_ab had to be raised along the ridge of constant V8 = 12.5%. delta_ab acts only while dosing (clr = delta_S + delta_ab*u_romo), so V1, V2, V7 and the V6/V14 hold-outs are unchanged to the digit; the cortical arm V8cort rises from +1.25% to +2.41%, still in the correct direction. From v2.10 it forms a correlated pair with sost_reb, jointly fitted and pinned by the two independent targets V8 and V16.

name: sost_reb
description: Plateau of the compensatory up-regulation of SOST transcription under sustained antibody exposure (added at v2.10). dA/dt = (sost_reb*u_romo - A)/tau_reb, with A = 0 at baseline and in every untreated scenario, so V1, V2, V7, V6 and V14 are structurally unaffected. After withdrawal the antibody clearance term vanishes but the up-regulation persists, so sclerostin overshoots and resorption surges, producing the post-withdrawal density loss V10. The calibration target is V16 (post-withdrawal CTX overshoot, clinically 1.2-1.4 times baseline), NOT V10 itself - which is why V10 remains a hold-out prediction. Forms a correlated pair with delta_ab along the ridge of constant V8 = 12.5%; V16 breaks the degeneracy.

name: tau_reb
description: Relaxation time constant of the compensatory SOST up-regulation (added at v2.10). Set from the clinical time course of rebound after romosozumab withdrawal: CTX peaks about 3 months after the last dose and returns to baseline by about 12 months, corresponding to a time constant of roughly 120 days. The bounds span 1-12 months.

name: K_P_sost
description: Half-saturation constant for PTH inhibition of SOST. Calibrated at v2.0 (surrogateopt, rng 20260722, fitted to V1/V2/V7/V8 with V6/V10/V14 held out); sets the sign and magnitude of V7. A large value means PTH inhibition of SOST is weak, consistent with Lemaire and Pivonka models that omit this pathway entirely. Compensates with lambda_P, so identifiability analysis is required.

name: lambda_T
description: Maximum fold up-regulation of SOST by TNF-alpha. Risks compensating with lambda_E, so profile likelihood is required.

name: K_T
description: Half-saturation constant for the action of TNF-alpha.

name: k_T
description: TNF-alpha production rate under oestrogen deficiency.

name: K_E
description: Half-saturation constant for oestrogen inhibition of TNF-alpha (E2 non-dimensionalised, premenopausal = 1).

name: n_E
description: Hill coefficient for oestrogen inhibition of TNF-alpha.

name: delta_T_tnf
description: TNF-alpha clearance rate.

name: n_ot_0
description: Baseline osteocyte density (defined as 1 by non-dimensionalisation).

name: n_ot_max
description: Upper bound on osteocyte density.

name: k_ot
description: Rate of osteocyte burial during bone formation.

name: gamma_ot
description: Proportionality coefficient for osteocyte removal by bone resorption.

name: delta_ot_0
description: Basal osteocyte apoptosis rate (rises with falling oestrogen and with age).

name: zeta
description: Exponent of the mechanosensing gain (n_ot/n_ot0)^zeta. This is the strength of the P3 positive feedback, and is scanned in E6 rather than fitted.

name: L_0
description: Baseline RANKL expression (dimensionless).

name: lambda_S
description: Maximum fold up-regulation of RANKL by sclerostin. Direction and order of magnitude follow the reported approximately 7-fold increase in osteoclastic activity.

name: K_L
description: Half-saturation constant for RANKL up-regulation by sclerostin.

name: lambda_P
description: Maximum fold up-regulation of RANKL by PTH. Calibrated at v2.0 (surrogateopt, rng 20260722, fitted to V1/V2/V7/V8 with V6/V10/V14 held out). Compensates with K_P_sost, so an identifiability profile is required.

name: K_PL
description: Half-saturation constant for RANKL up-regulation by PTH.

name: lambda_E
description: Coefficient of direct oestrogen inhibition of RANKL. Risks compensating with lambda_T, so the two must not be freed for fitting simultaneously.

name: O_0
description: Baseline OPG expression (dimensionless).

name: lambda_beta
description: Maximum fold up-regulation of OPG by beta-catenin.

name: K_beta
description: Half-saturation constant for OPG up-regulation by beta-catenin.

name: W_0
description: Baseline Wnt signalling strength (dimensionless).

name: K_W
description: Half-saturation constant for sclerostin inhibition of Wnt.

name: m_W
description: Hill coefficient for sclerostin inhibition of Wnt.

name: k_beta
description: beta-catenin production rate.

name: delta_beta
description: beta-catenin degradation rate.

name: D_R
description: Differentiation timescale of osteoblast precursors (= D_OBu, Pivonka Table 3). Agrees with the Lemaire placeholder.

name: D_B
description: Differentiation timescale of osteoblasts (= D_OBp, Pivonka Table 3). Corrected at v1.9 from 7e-4, a factor of about 7600 - responding osteoblasts differentiate very fast.

name: D_C
description: Differentiation timescale of osteoclast precursors (= D_OCp, Pivonka Table 3). Corrected at v1.9 from 2.1e-3, a factor of 100.

name: D_A
description: Osteoclast apoptosis rate (= A_OCa, Pivonka Table 3). Placeholder agreed with the source.

name: k_B
description: Osteoblast removal rate (= A_OBa, Pivonka Table 3). Placeholder agreed with the source.

name: K_L3
description: Half-saturation constant of RANKL for osteoclast differentiation. Must be taken from the source full text.

name: kappa_OPG
description: Competitive inhibition coefficient of OPG against RANKL. Must be taken from the source full text.

name: gamma_beta
description: Coefficient for beta-catenin promotion of osteoblast precursor proliferation.

name: gamma_surv
description: Coefficient for beta-catenin promotion of osteoblast survival.

name: C_s_TGF
description: TGF-beta activation coefficient (= K_D1,TGF-beta, Pivonka Table 3). Changed at v1.9 from 5e-3 to 4.545e-3.

name: R_0
description: Baseline concentration of osteoblast precursors (the non-dimensionalisation reference).

name: B_0
description: Baseline osteoblast concentration.

name: C_0
description: Baseline osteoclast concentration.

name: k_form
description: Surface deposition rate per unit osteoblast. Derived by balanceBoneFormation(p) from adult bone-mass balance, d(A_g*f_bm)/dt = 0, so it moves with k_res. Not a free parameter.

name: k_res
description: Surface resorption rate per unit osteoclast. Calibrated at v2.0 (surrogateopt, rng 20260722, fitted to V1/V2/V7/V8 with V6/V10/V14 held out); sets the V1 turnover rate to 7.19%/yr.

name: S_v_max
description: Peak of the specific-surface function (non-dimensionalised). Placeholder form: S_v = S_v_max * C * f^s1 * (1-f)^s2, pending replacement by the fifth-order polynomial of Martin 1984.

name: s1_Sv
description: First exponent of the specific-surface placeholder function. The peak lies at f_bm = s1/(s1+s2).

name: s2_Sv
description: Second exponent of the specific-surface placeholder function. s1 = 1 with s2 = 3 places the peak at f_bm = 0.25, matching Martin's intermediate-porosity maximum.

name: w_wall
description: Effective cortical wall thickness scale, used to convert surface rates into a rate of change of f_bm.

name: eps_model_star
description: Minimum effective strain threshold for periosteal modelling (Frost's MES_m, approximately 1000-1500 microstrain). Below it - and normal activity sits at 762 microstrain - there is no modelling, so the calibration scenarios are unaffected; above it, vigorous loading drives periosteal expansion. Added at v2.3 to separate Frost modelling from remodelling.

name: k_model
description: Periosteal modelling deposition rate per unit strain excess. Added at v2.3: it drives periosteal expansion directly from strain, produces the Haapasalo geometric gains (V6a-e), and is self-limiting (r_p up raises the second moment of area, which lowers strain). V6 is a hold-out, so this value is set on physical grounds and not fitted.

name: eps_model_sat
description: Half-saturation strain excess for periosteal modelling (added at v2.6). modeling = k_model*excess/(1 + excess/eps_sat), with excess = max(0, eps_p - eps_model_star). Two independent arguments converge on the same value: (1) at half-saturation the total strain is eps_model_star + eps_sat = 1500 + 5500 = 7000 microstrain, the yield strain of cortical bone, beyond which tissue enters damage rather than adaptation and Frost's linear relation cannot be extrapolated; (2) the implied rate ceiling v_max = k_model*eps_sat = 1.93 micrometres/day falls within the documented mineral apposition rate for rapid modelling and woven bone (approximately 1-5 micrometres/day). This correction removes the runaway periosteal artefact, which in the pathological state had demanded 1513 mm/yr.

name: chi_drift
description: Fraction of periosteal modelling deposition accompanied by endocortical resorption (added at v2.11). dr_e is incremented by chi_drift*modeling. Frost's modelling drift translates the cortex outward rather than merely inflating it; chi_drift = 1 is pure translation, preserving cortical wall thickness, while 0 recovers the v2.10 behaviour of adding without translating. The value 1.0 is a choice of principle (pure translation), NOT a fit to V6e - which is why V6e remains a hold-out. The term rides on modelling, so it inherits both that term's strain threshold (never triggered in any calibration scenario) and its saturation bound.

name: m_prim
description: Fraction of mineralisation achieved immediately as primary mineralisation.

name: kappa_m
description: Secondary (maturation) mineralisation rate. Added at v2.3 as the maturation term of the intensive rho_min ODE; the half-time of about 3.8 years matches the multi-year timescale of secondary mineralisation. Being slow, it prevents maturation from masking the post-withdrawal density loss V10.

name: mu_turn_0
description: Baseline mineralisation turnover rate, by which newly formed bone dilutes rho_min. Added at v2.3 so that rho_min falls as formation rises (new bone is less mineralised), which is what produces V6f. Its magnitude corresponds to the V1 turnover of about 7%/yr.

name: xi_p_0
description: Baseline allocation of resorption to the periosteal surface (adult periosteal resorption is minimal).

name: xi_e_0
description: Baseline allocation of resorption to the endocortical surface.

name: xi_i_0
description: Baseline allocation of resorption to the intracortical surface.

name: lambda_xi
description: Coefficient by which TNF-alpha biases resorption towards the endocortical surface. Determines the postmenopausal geometric phenotype V15.

name: a_p_abs
description: Passive fraction of intestinal calcium absorption. Awaits Peterson & Riggs 2010.

name: a_a_abs
description: Maximum active fraction of intestinal calcium absorption. Awaits Peterson & Riggs 2010.

name: K_I_abs
description: Half-saturation constant of active absorption with respect to intake. Awaits Peterson & Riggs 2010. The key parameter behind the plateau shape of V7.

name: K_VD
description: Half-saturation constant for 1,25D promotion of active absorption. Awaits Peterson & Riggs 2010.

name: phi_res
description: Relative contribution of bone resorption to the serum calcium set point (dimensionless). From v1.8, serum calcium is treated by quasi-steady-state approximation, so this is the bone calcium flux relative to the constitutive flux and should be far below 1 (skeletal calcium pool versus daily turnover).

name: phi_form
description: Relative contribution of bone formation to the serum calcium set point (dimensionless). See phi_res.

name: P_max
description: Maximum PTH secretion rate (dimensionless). Awaits Peterson & Riggs 2010.

name: Ca_50
description: Serum calcium concentration at half-maximal inhibition of PTH secretion (ionised calcium).

name: n_P
description: Hill coefficient of PTH secretion with respect to serum calcium (steep).

name: delta_P
description: PTH clearance rate (= k_7D, 7.143/h = 171/day, half-life 5.8 min, Peterson-Riggs Table 2). Corrected at v1.9 from 48.

name: k_VD
description: 1,25D production rate (PTH-driven). Awaits Peterson & Riggs 2010.

name: K_VP
description: Half-saturation constant for PTH promotion of 1,25D production.

name: delta_VD
description: 1,25D clearance rate (half-life of several hours to a day).

name: Ca_s_0
description: Baseline serum ionised calcium.

name: renal_k
description: Renal excretion rate coefficient. Awaits Peterson & Riggs 2010.

name: renal_Ca_th
description: Threshold for renal tubular calcium reabsorption.

name: renal_lambda_P
description: Coefficient for PTH promotion of renal tubular calcium reabsorption.

name: kappa_Ca
description: Rate of serum calcium homeostasis (quasi-steady-state approximation). Serum calcium is held constant by the calcium-sensing receptor and PTH on a timescale of minutes, far faster than bone remodelling (days to months). Sets how strongly serum calcium buffers perturbations.

name: n_renal
description: Hill steepness of renal excretion with respect to serum calcium. The filtered calcium load is proportional to serum calcium and tubular reabsorption is saturable, so excretion rises steeply for small increases in serum calcium - the main mechanism by which serum calcium is held within about 2%.

name: I_Ca_0
description: Baseline dietary calcium intake (the centre of the low- and high-calcium arms of experiment E2).

name: V_D_0
description: Baseline 1,25D (defined by non-dimensionalisation).

name: E2_0
description: Baseline oestrogen (defined as 1 premenopausally by non-dimensionalisation; postmenopausal scenarios set it to 0.1).
